senses.gloss: रौ॑द्र or रौद्र॑, mf(आ or ई)n. (fr. रुद्र) relating or belonging to or coming from Rudra or the Rudras, Rudra-like, violent, impetuous, fierce, wild (अम् ind.), RV. &c. &c.
bringing or betokening misfortune, inauspicious, R.; Var.
रौ॑द्र m. a descendant of Rudra, MBh.
a worshipper of Rudra, W.
(pl., or sg. with गण) a class of evil spirits, Hariv.
(scil. रस) the sentiment of wrath or fury, Sāh.; Pratāp.
N. of Yama, L.
the cold season of the year, winter, L.
a partic. Ketu, VarBṛS.
N. of the 54th year of the Jupiter cycle of 60 years, ib.
(pl.) N. of a people, MBh.
रौ॑द्र m. n. heat, warmth, sunshine, L.
रौ॑द्र mf(ई)n. N. of the Nakṣatra Ārdrā when under Rudra, VarBṛS.
रौ॑द्र n. savageness, fierceness, formidableness, Kathās.; Suśr.
N. of a Liṅga, Cat.
of various Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
रौ॑द्री (ई), f. N. of Gaurī, L.
one of the 9 Samidhs, Gṛhyās.
a partic. Śakti, Hcat.
(in music.) a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.
a partic. Mūrchanā, ib.
a species of creeper, L.
N. of the Comms. on the Tattva-cintāmaṇi-dīdhiti and the Nyāya-siddhānta-muktāvalī by Rudra Bhaṭṭācārya
(with मेघ-माला and शान्ति) of two older works.
रौद्री in comp. for रुद्र.
रौद्रि m. patr. fr. रुद्र, Hariv.
रौ॑द्रम् अम्, ind.
रौद्र—कर्मन् n. a terrible magic rite or one performed for some dreadful purpose, Cat.
रौद्र—कर्मन् mfn. doing t˚ acts, MBh.
रौद्र—कर्मन् m. (also ˚मिन्) N. of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, ib.
रौद्र—ता f. wild or savage state, dreadfulness, R.; Mālatīm.
रौद्र—दंष्ट्र mfn. having terrible tusks or fangs, BhP.
रौद्र—दर्शन mfn. of dreadful appearance, terrific, W. (cf. रुद्र-द्˚).
रौद्र—नेत्रा f. N. of a Buddhistic goddess, Kālac.
रौद्र—पाद (prob.) N. of the Nakṣatra Ārdrā, Kṛṣis.
रौ॑द्र—मनस् (रौ॑द्र-), mfn. savage-minded, fierce, ŚBr.
रौद्र-र्क्ष n. N. of the Nakṣatra Ārdrā, VarBṛS.
रौद्रक n. Rudra's work (= रुद्रेण कृतम्) g. कुलालादि.
रौद्राक्ष mf(ई)n. (fr. रुद्राक्ष) made from Elaeocarpus Ganitrus, Anarghar.
रौद्राग्न mf(ई)n. (fr. रुद्राग्नि) relating to Rudra and Agni, ĀśvŚr.
रौद्राणी (prob.) w.r. for रुद्राणी.
रौद्रायण m. (also pl.) patr. fr. रुद्र, Pravar.
रौद्राश्व m. (prob. fr. रुद्राश्व) N. of a son or a more distant descendant of Puru, MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.
of a Ṛṣi, Cat.
रौद्री—करण n. the doing dreadful acts, performing horrors, MānŚr.
रौद्री—भाव m. ‘terribleness’, the character of Rudra or Śiva, MBh.
